definitions.explanation: the temperature at which a solid becomes a liquid

examples.japanese: {氷|こおり}の{融解点|ゆうかいてん}は{零度|れいど}だ。
examples.english: The melting point of ice is zero degrees.

examples.japanese: {金|きん}は{融解点|ゆうかいてん}が{非常|ひじょう}に{高|たか}い。
examples.english: Gold has a very high melting point.

examples.japanese: {物質|ぶっしつ}の{融解点|ゆうかいてん}を{調|しら}べることで、その{純度|じゅんど}を{確認|かくにん}することができる。
examples.english: By examining a substance's melting point, you can verify its purity.

notes:
Composed of {融解|ゆうかい} (melting; dissolution) + {点|てん} (point). The melting point and {凝固点|ぎょうこてん} (freezing point) are the same temperature for a given substance — the difference is the direction of the phase change. In everyday Japanese, {融点|ゆうてん} is more commonly used as the short form.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {融解点|ゆうかいてん}が{高|たか}い: to have a high melting point
- {融解点|ゆうかいてん}が{低|ひく}い: to have a low melting point
- {融解点|ゆうかいてん}に{達|たっ}する: to reach the melting point
- {融解点|ゆうかいてん}を{測定|そくてい}する: to measure the melting point

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {融点|ゆうてん}: melting point — the shorter, more common synonym
- {凝固点|ぎょうこてん}: freezing point — the temperature at which a liquid solidifies (same temperature, opposite direction)
- {沸点|ふってん}: boiling point — the temperature at which a liquid becomes gas
